sources.quote: SC-BR225-YS,BR-225,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev B) for BR-225 requires MAT-6082-T6 (EN AW-6082-T6). The proposed EN AW-7075 is a different grade, so it does not meet the drawing material. Its capability against the 250 MPa yield characteristic SC-BR225-YS is not documented anywhere. The material has no id in the glossary, so the key uses the name as said in the meeting.

EN AW-7075 is not in the glossary or in any document we hold, so there is no material master data for it. A person must supply its properties, such as yield strength, and confirm whether it suits anodising (COAT-ANOD) before a decision.

No 3.1 material certificate for EN AW-7075 is in the documents. The only approval on record for BR-225 from SUP-B covers the part with its current drawing material. A person must say whether a 3.1 certificate for EN AW-7075 exists.
